title: Cation-disordered rocksalt cathode for anode-free zinc-ion batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5EE02643A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Zixuan Li, Rui Qi, Yi Yuan, Lechen Yang, Lijiang Song, Ashok S. Menon, Louis F. J. Piper, Didier Wermeille, Paul Thompson, Robert A. House, Peter G. Bruce, Alex W. Robertson
The first application of disordered rocksalt (DRX) materials in aqueous zinc-ion batteries (ZIBs) demonstrates DRX ZnMnO2 as a versatile cathode for anode-free configurations, overcoming zinc anode degradation challenges.
